products.name: Cloud Identity as Enterprise IdP — SAML App Integration Factory (SSO at Scale) — Commercial
products.short_description: Build a SAML app-integration factory with Cloud Identity/Workspace as IdP — a repeatable SAML/OIDC onboarding pattern, auto-provisioning, group-based assignment, and a catalog — so the SaaS estate federates to Google SSO fast and consistently. Self-guided, tested, a fraction of consulting cost.
products.description:
Make Google the single sign-on identity provider for your SaaS estate

In a Google-first enterprise, Cloud Identity / Google Workspace becomes the IdP for hundreds of SaaS apps — but onboarding each SAML/OIDC app one-off is slow and inconsistent. This solution builds a repeatable SAML app-integration factory: a standard onboarding pattern (SAML & OIDC), auto-provisioning where supported, group-based app assignment, and a catalog/runbook — so new apps are federated to Google SSO fast, consistently, and securely.

Run it yourself — simpler, cheaper, and proven

You do not need a consultant. The package hands you the field-tested method as self-guided, click-by-click documentation a competent admin can follow end to end — backed by ready-to-run Python (gcloud / Cloud Client Libraries).

  • Simpler — exact, ordered steps with full navigation paths; every object you create is named and reused through testing and troubleshooting.
  • Cheaper — one fixed price instead of an open meter; a comparable consulting engagement runs well into the thousands per day. Reusable on every rollout.
  • Tested — a pilot-first method (Assess → Configure → Pilot → Validate → Expand) with explicit pass/fail gates.

What's inside

  • Solution Overview — Google as IdP: SAML vs OIDC, the app catalog, auto-provisioning, group-based assignment, and the repeatable onboarding pattern.
  • Requirements Guide — each prerequisite with how to verify/implement (Cloud Identity/Workspace tenant + super-admin, groups source of truth, per-app admin access).
  • Implementation Guide — define the onboarding pattern, integrate a pilot set of SAML/OIDC apps, wire auto-provisioning + group-based assignment, and publish the catalog/runbook — then scale the factory.
  • 5 Python tools — assessment/discovery, a configuration or provisioning helper, a validation/report generator, a policy/guardrail check, and a scope/config helper — authentic gcloud / Cloud Client Library automation (read-only or dry-run by default; no credentials or keys in code).
  • Validation gates (SSO works, provisioning correct, assignment group-driven) plus Best Practices for a consistent, auditable app-integration program.

The repeatable way

Every solution follows the same repeatable shape, so each deployment feels familiar and low-risk — buy once, reuse the playbook for the next wave and the next project.

The bottom line

Google as the single sign-on IdP for the whole SaaS estate — apps onboarded by a repeatable factory, provisioned and assigned by group — fast, consistent, auditable.

What you receive — every file in your download

This package is delivered as downloadable files you keep and reuse across unlimited devices — nothing is left out and nothing else is required:

  • Implementation Guide (PDF) — the complete, click-by-click solution: solution overview, requirements, step-by-step implementation, testing & validation, troubleshooting, best practices.
  • Automation Scripts (ZIP) — 5 ready-to-run scripts (read-only discovery/validation/reporting; remediation defaults to a safe preview):
    • assignment_guardrail_check.py — enforce group-only assignment + NameID standard (read-only guardrail)
    • catalog_config_helper.py — append a correctly-shaped app row to the catalog + emit its checklist
    • saml_app_onboarding_helper.py — generate the standardized onboarding checklist + attribute map for an app
    • sso_readiness_assessment.py — read-only SSO/provisioning readiness baseline for the SaaS estate
    • sso_validation_report.py — validate the app catalog for completeness + cert expiry (read-only report)

Delivered as a Word document and PDF, plus all Python scripts and tools in a single ZIP — yours to keep and reuse.
